title: π
description: The ratio of every circle's circumference to its width, the same for all of them, and never ending or repeating. Archimedes trapped it between polygons. Unlocks the π Crystal.

puzzle.goal: A regular polygon of n sides is drawn inside a circle of diameter 1. Write its perimeter P.
puzzle.name: Archimedes' polygon
puzzle.ask: Find P for n = @{n} (Archimedes' own polygon).
puzzle.method: Each side spans an angle 2π/n at the centre, so it is 2·(1/2)·sin(π/n) long.
